objects.name: Detection technique coverage: multiple-archive-files-http-post-traffic
objects.description: The following analytic detects the high-frequency exfiltration of archive files via HTTP POST requests. It leverages HTTP stream logs to identify specific archive file headers within the request body. This activity is significant as it often indicates data exfiltration by APTs or trojan spyware after data collection.
